title: Irrigation Methods and Water Efficiency Improvements
reason: Discusses various methods and approaches to increase water use efficiency in irrigation.

tasks.task: Explain the need for reducing water losses in irrigation.

subtasks.text: Highlight the fact that almost 50% of abstracted water for irrigation is wasted from evaporation, leakage, or spillage.
Mention that night irrigation can be an example of a managerial response to avoid evaporation.

tasks.task: Describe the need to improve irrigation systems and techniques.

subtasks.text: Mention that the commonly used irrigation methods today are surface irrigation like flood irrigation, sprinkler irrigation, drip irrigation, and subsurface irrigation.
Point out that flood irrigation produces excessive evaporation and causes soil salinization.

tasks.task: Explain the importance of shifting to more efficient irrigation methods.

subtasks.text: Recommend shifting to drip irrigation or subsurface irrigation, which are the most water-efficient methods.
Highlight the need to improve soil water holding capacity by adding organic matter.

tasks.task: Discuss the role of crop selection in water savings.

subtasks.text: Mention that certain crops have the ability to take up water from deeper soil layers, like sorghum and sunflower.
Describe how the SRI or System of Rice Intensification method in Asia uses a more water-efficient rice variety.
